fields.description: Live: real-time, batch-of-1, submitted within seconds of Sales Invoice submission. Backlog: true multi-invoice bulk submission during/after a WhiteBooks outage recovery. See docs/designs/gst-asp-migration-whitebooks.md, Approach C.
fields.label: Submission Path

fields.description: Which WhiteBooks credential pair/base URL this submission used (Rohit Settings.sandbox_mode at submission time) - logged explicitly so a sandbox-vs-production credential mixup is visible here, not silent.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: The ID used to correlate an outbound WhiteBooks call with its later async webhook result, and to dedupe a replayed/duplicate webhook delivery against this entry - see the design doc's webhook idempotency requirement.
fields.label: Submission ID

fields.description: When this submission was made - the transaction view-lock's date field for this doctype (see LOCKED_DOCTYPE_DATE_FIELDS in transaction_lock.py). A live-path entry unresolved more than a few seconds past this timestamp is the anomaly the alerting task (T12) watches for.
fields.label: Submitted On
